messages:
Alex G: Taking the sunset shift (18:00-02:00 PDT) — quick pre-oncall sanity check :wave:
Alex G: TL;DR — VPN, pager, SSH key all validated. Leaving runbook + a couple notes below.
Maria S: Thanks! can you paste the runbook link and any one-off creds or commands we should know?
Alex G: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-sunset-shift  — see sections 'nightly backfills' and 'gpu-pool-failover'. No new creds; uses existing service account (svc_oncall).
Alex G: Pager check (my account):
```
$ pagerctl whoami
alexg@redwood
```
OpsBot: Reminder: pager rotation swap for 1977000000 completed.
Jordan H: Confirm VPN is okay? my laptop started failing corporate cert after latest macOS update.
Alex G: VPN profile is 'redwood-corp'. If cert errors, run:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/renew-cert && openvpn --config ~/.vpn/redwood.ovpn
```
Worked for me on Big Sur/Monterey.
Samir T: Any hot TODOs or services I should watch during the shift?
Alex G: Watch gpu-inference-prod — there's a nightly shard job that can spike memory and latency. Alert: latency > 800ms for 3m. If mem pressure, restart node pool: `./infra/restart-gpu-pool --region us-west-2 --graceful` (runbook includes RBAC steps).
Maria S: Mobile push to pager tested? SMS fallback?
Alex G: Yup — Android push + SMS fallback verified. Escalation set to Jordan after 30m.
Jordan H: I still don't have pager access in my account — @Ops can you confirm I'm in the SlackPager group?
OpsBot: Ops note: Jordan H added to SlackPager and PagerDuty team 'sunset-tier' at 1977000025.
Samir T: If you see alerts about 'kv-cache-missed' during the first 10-12m of the shard job, ignore for first 2 mins — expected resync. Logs: /var/log/kv-sync.log
Alex G: Leaving now. If anything, DM me. :thumbsup:
Jordan H: Thanks — will ack any alerts. good handoff.
